'''Roovo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|green]] skinned Rodian [[Gender/Legends|male]] with the large black eyes characteristic of his [[Species/Legends|species]], he was one of many of his species who settled on Taris. Roovo wore light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for protection from the world's wildlife. He sold weapons from his shop in [[Olaris]], the headquarters of the Republic-sponsored [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roovo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Taris.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Roovo was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
